thread:
Lena: Small but important design review note 1: our in-console label says "routing policy" while the docs and API call it "routing rule". Users clicking "Learn more" get dropped on a page titled "Routing rules" and have to search. Can we pick one?

Omar: Yikes, that's confusing. API telemetry and SDKs use "routing_rule" so I vote we normalize to "routing rule" everywhere.

Priya: +1 to "routing rule". For UI brevity we can use "Rule" in table columns and keep "Routing rule" in help copy. I'll update the DS tokens.

Ava: Accessibility catch: the help panel link text is just "Learn more". For screen readers that's ambiguous. Prefer "Learn more about routing rules (opens in new tab)" or add sr-only text.

Lena: Also noticed deep-links from the panel omit the hash. Console sends /docs/serving/routing not /docs/serving/routing#rules which is why users land at top. We should link to absolute URL + hash.

Omar: Implementation plan: 1) change panel links to absolute links with hash. 2) pass an aria-label token to the Link component. 3) on the docs side, ensure router preserves the hash and sets focus to the anchor (tabindex=-1 then focus).

Priya: Design tokens: label.short.routing = "Rule"; label.long.routing = "Routing rule"; link.accessibility.routing = "Routing rules docs (opens in new tab)". I'll push tokens and update Figma components.

Ava: Dev notes for docs team: when the anchor is loaded, set tabindex=-1 and focus it. If there's a sticky header add a small scroll offset. Sample: 
```
const id = location.hash?.slice(1);
const el = document.getElementById(id) || document.getElementById('main');
if (el) { el.setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); window.scrollBy(0,-80); el.focus({preventScroll:true}); }
```

Omar: Also add alias anchors for legacy terms #routing-policy that include a short badge: "This page previously used the term 'routing policy' which now maps to 'routing rule'." That prevents broken bookmarks.

Priya: Who owns what? I can do tokens + Figma updates (ETA 2d). Omar can do console link changes + small e2e (ETA 3d). Lena can file the docs alias + focus snippet (ETA 1d). Ava will do accessibility review after PRs.

docs-bot: Created task #5467: "Normalize 'routing policy' -> 'routing rule' across console, docs, and DS; add anchors, a11y labels, and focus handling" assigned to Priya, Omar, Lena.

Lena: Thanks team. After merge let's run a quick session with VoiceOver and confirm keyboard flow. :thumbsup:
